lines.en: label christmastwo15:
scene secretsantatime1
: Life can be all sorts of things. Happy. Sad. All of the emotions that occur in the middle-
: But noodles will always be noodles.
: And once you lose sight of that, you have lost at both life and at Christmas.
: The moral of the story is to cherish your friends, because you never know when one of them might become a slice of pork or a cracked bowl.
: The end.
: I forget. What was it we were talkin’ about again?
: I believe it was the topic of tradition. Though, I’m struggling to see how any of what was just said pertains to that.
: You should really consider putting more points into charisma next time, Kendo Princess. None of us understood any of that speech.
scene secretsantatime2
: I apologize for derailing this conversation. I simply wanted to say that I would enjoy doing this again with all of you in the future.
: But, on the bright side, the mood seems to be a bit lighter now.
scene secretsantatime3
: Hey, yeah! It kinda does! Look at us, movin’ past all the bad stuff and gettin’ back to what really brings all of us here today! Christmas!
: It’s gettin’ to be around time for Secret Santa, which I’m really friggin’ pumped about since I wasn’t able to do it with you guys last year.
: Aren’t we still missing a few people, though?
scene secretsantatime4
: Are we? I saw Yumi walk back in a couple of minutes ago, so I kinda figured that was everybody.
: It looks like...several people are missing, actually. But we have more than half, so...
: Are you still worried about whether or not the Herald of the Adolescents will enjoy your gift?
scene secretsantatime5
: I’m more worried about whether or not he’ll ever like me again. I rolled a nat-one when I tried talking to him the other night and I might have somehow made things even worse.
scene secretsantatime6
: Well, I am certainly excited for this gift exchange.
: It will be my first time receiving something from a classmate, so I’m sure that whatever gift I am given will find its place in a loving home.
: You haven’t gotten yours yet, Touka? I saw you carryin’ around a stuffed bear thingy before and kinda assumed that was just your present.
: Oh, no. Not at all. That was-
scene secretsantatime7
: Wait! Where did the bear go?! It was on the counter behind Tsuneyo just a moment ago!
: It is likely gone forever.
: Fission mailed.
: No, no, no! That’s not good! It was my duty to look after it! We need to find it!
: Ugh. Fine. But I’m only givin’ it five minutes before I pull the plug and start Secret Santa without it.
scene black
scene secretsantatime8
: Uhh...Sana?...
scene secretsantatime9
: Hm?
scene secretsantatime10
: Ah! Wha...what did I do? Why are you-
: I ain’t here to pick on you. Just heard some shit about my mom workin’ at your bar or whatever and I...wanted to see if it was true, I guess.
scene secretsantatime11
: So, you’re...not here to...pick on me?...
: Have I ever picked on you before? Why the fuck would I start now?
: You haven’t, but...I’m easy to miss, so...
: Listen, I’m not plannin’ on bothering you or whatever. I just wanna know if the shit I’ve been hearin’ is true.
: You probably know her as Yuki. But I’ve known her since I was a kid and-
scene secretsantatime12
: Well...obviously I’ve known her since I was a kid since she’s my fucking mom.
: But, like...she ain’t ever worked a real job in her whole fuckin’ life. And I can’t figure out why the fuck she’d...start now instead of just doin’ what she’s always done.
: I’ve...heard from her that...you two aren’t on very good terms...
scene secretsantatime13
: It’s true, then? She’s really working there? She like a...bodyguard or something?
: We aren’t...busy enough to hire any bodyguards...
: She’s just a...normal bartender...
: She hasn’t...been there long, but...she’s doing her best...
: That’s...
: I just don’t really get why.
: But I don’t really expect you to know either.
scene secretsantatime14
: Uhh...anyway! That was pretty much it.
: I’m gonna...probably go back to the other room to chill with Chika for a bit, so as long as you ain’t got anything you need to ask me, I’ll-
scene secretsantatime15
: Attention, attention! All ladies and Sensei!
scene secretsantatime16
: I know we’re still missing a few people, but the time has come for us to give each other stuff so we don’t miss out on the fireworks later!
: If the person you’re supposed to give a present to isn’t here, by no means give it to Touka! She has proven she can not be trusted with looking after presents!
: Uta, please! I’m sure it will turn up somewhere! I just have to-
: No excuses, bear killer!
: Everyone, go! Go, go, go!
scene black
One by one, all of the girls begin making their way over to the table that they’d left all of their gifts on shortly after entering the party.
Thankfully, I manage to avoid getting caught up in the congestion as I reclaimed Miku’s present from Touka (Unbeknownst to her) just a few minutes ago.
Feeling ever so slightly bad about watching her frantically search the room for it, I let her know that it’s not lost after all and that she’s free to live at least a temporarily guilt free life.
Touka breathes a sigh of relief and, without saying anything else, walks directly past me and over to an...extremely large gift wrapped object that I somehow did not notice at all tonight.
Knowing that it’s time for me to actually be a decent person and give someone something, I glance over at Rin one final time to make sure she’s doing okay now.
Futaba was able to calm her down for the most part. And I-
Well, I was there.
But that’s more than I can say most of the time.
Now, I should probably get this bear over to Miku before I get sidetracked and-
: Umm...Sir!
Nevermind, I guess.
scene secretsantatime17
: I know things are...not the best between us right now and...that you still haven’t...sorted out your feelings, but...
: But I got this for you...
: You mean to tell me that the hypothetical scenario you threw out the other night about buying me a present was actually true?
: S...Surprise~
scene secretsantatime18
: Thank you, Molly. I appreciate it.
: This seems a little large to be a gift card, though.

: It’s actually...something I made. The mats for it did technically run a bit under the spending limit, but it took a little while to put together, so...I hope that makes up for the discrepancy in spending...
: Can I open it now?
scene secretsantatime19
: Now?! Why?!
: Because it’s...a present for me?...
: Yes! I mean no! Don’t open it!
scene secretsantatime20
: At the very least, Sir...please wait until you make it back home...
: It would be...a bit embarrassing seeing you try it on now...
: Please tell me you did not make me some sort of cosplay outfit.
scene secretsantatime21
: Of course not. Though, it is certainly something in the...apparel family.
: I just figured that since summer is right around the corner, this might come in handy.
: So you don’t find it strange that summer is right around the corner from Christmas?
scene secretsantatime22
: That’s...
: Wait...
: Summer is still quite a way’s away if today is Christmas...
: So...what? Why did I feel the need to make you-
: *Hic*
scene secretsantatime23
: You doing okay, Nodoka?
: I...hic...held the glass for too long...
: Is this what normal people look like when they’re drunk?
: She’s incredibly less annoying than I heard I was.
: I say we don’t talk about how you are when you’re drunk.
scene secretsantatime24
: Yes...right.
: I’m sorry, Sir...
: You ever hic take a second to think about how fucking wild tardigrades are?
: They can live in fucking lava. Can you live in lava, Sensei?
: Nodoka, when did this even happen to you? You were fine just a few minutes ago.
: I don’t remember. Some time after Otoha decided she didn’t want her parents knowing she fucks girls.
scene secretsantatime25
: Uhh...okay. I’m going to walk away now. But...thank you for accepting my present, Sir. I...hope you enjoy it.
: You can...let me know if...you ever decide to text me back.
: Nooo, don’t go~
: I didn’t mean that Otoha is actually fucking Rin. She just probably thinks about fucking Rin.
: But we all think about fucking Rin. She’s Rin. She’s fuckable.
: Nodoka...we are literally right here...
scene secretsantatime26
: Heeeeeey~
: Don’t “heeeeeey” me, please. Go get a bottle of water and lay down.
: Can I lay on your lap?
: No. I’m helping Rin right now.
: Rin? You mean the fuckable one?
: Is it weird that this is actually making me feel a little bit better right now?
: Merry Christmas, Sir. I’m walking away now.
: Yeah, so am I. As much as I like this conversation, this is probably the last place I should be getting involved in it.
scene black
Besides, I have other things to do right now and-
: Senpai!
Hah...
scene secretsantatime27
: Nobody got me a Christmas present! This is the single worst party I’ve ever crashed! And I’ve crashed at least three parties! Three!
: I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume that’s because you’ve been a part of the class for one day.
scene secretsantatime28
: Sure, yeah...but that doesn’t mean it doesn’t still hurt.
: Will you buy me a present, Senpai? Pleeeeeease?
: No. Go away.
scene secretsantatime29
: Nothing?! Not even an innuendo for me to feed off of?!
: I’m busy right now. Just let me drop this thing off and then we can practice our...innuendo trading.
scene secretsantatime30
: Fine. Give it here.
: I’m a little too old for stuffed animals, but I guess this’ll have to do.
: Imani.
: What, dude? You said you needed to drop that thing off. I’ve got arms. I can handle the drop.
scene black
: Maybe next year.
If she’s even still around next year.
Based on my current track record, though, I think it’s probably safe to assume she will be.
Unless tonight ends with another dramatic turn of events, of course.
But I should probably find a tomboy to give this bear to before that winds up being the case.
scene secretsantatime31
: Makoto, where-
: Woah. What’s wrong?
: What am I supposed to do with this, Sensei?!
: It’s a picture, so...I think you’re supposed to hang it up?
scene secretsantatime32
: It’s worth a million yen! I’ve never even touched anything this expensive before!
: That is well over the $20 spending limit.
: I knew something like this might happen when we set the limit in US dollars! Touka barely understands the value of our currency, let alone a foreign one!
: You know, I was wondering what the reasoning behind that was when I saw it written on the board the other day, but I decided against asking.
: I need your help! I don’t know what to do with this thing!
: I will gladly take it off your hands.
scene secretsantatime33
: Not that kind of help! I need your help returning it! I can barely even hold this thing up! It’s too heavy!
: Yeah, it must be really tough having all of that wealth in the palms of your hands. Poor you.
scene secretsantatime34
: Ugh...why did she think something like this was okay?
: That aside, have you seen Miku? I have to give her this present.
scene secretsantatime35
: Miku? Yeah. She went outside to get some air a little while ago when things started getting loud.
: Is that...stuffed animal you’re carrying for her?
: Yeah. I didn’t really know what else to get and it kind of just jumped out at me.
: And you...didn’t think she was too boyish to enjoy something like that?
scene secretsantatime36
: I have no idea if she’ll enjoy it or not. It’s just what I bought. If she likes it, she likes it. If she doesn’t-
: Makoto?
scene secretsantatime37
: She’s probably somewhere on the side of the hotel, where you can’t see any of the other buildings or cars or anything.
: So...as far away from everything that she can possibly be right now without completely abandoning the party.
: Oh. Uhh, okay.
: I guess I’ll just head out there now then.
: And I’ll...be here. Stuck standing in place with this extremely valuable painting.
: I believe in you, Makoto. If there’s anyone good at not being crushed by the weight of responsibility and obligation, it’s you.
scene secretsantatime38
: Okay. You can leave now.
: And I will do just that. See you later.
scene black
